abstract: Evaluates hazardous material and biological containment readiness
system_message:
You are the Environmental Health & Safety Officer (EHS), responsible for evaluating hazardous material and biological containment readiness as well as workplace safety records across potential cold-chain pharmaceutical logistics partners.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Workplace injury metrics（OSHA）
information_points.content:
EHS-OSHA-2RI：Polaris Pharma Freight Solutions recorded a total recordable incident rate of 1.2 incidents per 200000 operational work hours covering driver and warehouse personnel over the prior calendar year.
EHS-OSHA-T0L：Apex TempLogistics Group logged a total recordable incident rate of 1.8 incidents per 200000 operational work hours across its driver and warehouse labor force over the prior calendar year.
EHS-OSHA-G8T：BioRoute Express International maintained a total recordable incident rate of 0.6 incidents per 200000 operational work hours for driver and warehouse staff over the prior calendar year.

information_points.title: Evaluates hazardous material and biological containment readiness（SPILL）
information_points.content:
EHS-SPILL-PBL：During the Audit period of Q1 2026, BioRoute Express International secured verified biocontainment spill protocol clearance following an assessment of carrier emergency containment kits and trained hazmat personnel.
EHS-SPILL-EKF：For the Audit period of Q2 2026, Apex TempLogistics Group did not hold verified biocontainment spill protocol clearance based on biosafety evaluations of its carrier hazmat emergency containment kits and personnel.
EHS-SPILL-XJB：For the Audit period of Q1 2026, Apex TempLogistics Group received verified biocontainment spill protocol clearance based on an evaluation of its carrier hazmat emergency containment kits and response personnel.
EHS-SPILL-GPM：For the Audit period of Q1 2026, Polaris Pharma Freight Solutions did not attain verified biocontainment spill protocol clearance during the evaluation of its hazmat response personnel and containment kits.
